Business-operation validation methods must evaluate their rules through a validation collector.

Back to STX rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Business-operation validation methods must evaluate their rules through a validation collector. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the The Standard family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0012: Business-operation validation methods must evaluate their rules through a validation collector.
private static void ValidateStudentOnAdd(Student newStudent)
{
    if (newStudent is null)
    {
        throw new NullStudentException();
    }
}

Good code example

// Follows STX0012
private static void ValidateStudentOnAdd(Student newStudent) =>
    Validate(
        message: "Student is invalid.",
        (Rule: IsInvalid(newStudent.Id), Parameter: nameof(Student.Id)),
        (Rule: IsInvalid(newStudent.Name), Parameter: nameof(Student.Name)));

private static void Validate(
    string message,
    params (dynamic Rule, string Parameter)[] validations)
{
    var invalidStudentException = new InvalidStudentException(message);

    foreach ((dynamic rule, string parameter) in validations)
    {
        if (rule.Condition)
        {
            invalidStudentException.UpsertDataList(
                key: parameter,
                value: rule.Message);
        }
    }

    invalidStudentException.ThrowIfContainsErrors();
}
